probe_finding: Definition (author @RyNoonan, 4for4, read 2026-10-15): tackles and assists in the NFL are credited by the HOME team's official scorekeeper, and scorekeepers differ systematically in how generously they award assists — so the same defensive performance records different tackle totals in different buildings. The author adjusts his tackle/assist projections (the C-300 market) for the home scorekeeper's assist-crediting tendency. Family: market/prop context. Role in-engine: a venue-effect input of exactly the kind the situational layer exists to carry — invisible in player stats, decisive for tackle props, and measurable from public credits once someone builds the table. It belongs beside C-297 (crew assignment) as a 'the building and its officials are inputs' record.
